newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAS one-day strike halts 92% of domestic flights.
newsitem.headline: JAS one-day strike halts 92% of domestic flights.

text.p: Japan Air System Co Ltd (JAS) said on Wednesday its two labour unions went on a day-long strike, leading to the cancellation of 92 percent of its domestic flights.
JAS is Japan's third-largest carrier and operates mostly domestic flights.
The strike went into effect as talks between the unions and the company's management on employees' summer bonuses broke off, a JAS spokeswoman said.
The strike affected about 44,000 passengers as it led to the cancellation of 361 flights along 86 routes, or 92 percent of the company's total domestic flights, she said.
The two international flights scheduled for Wednesday were not affected, she added.
It was the first time in four years that the pilots' union went on strike and the first time in five years that the union for flight attendants and ground staff went on strike, the spokeswoman said.
